data.name: Evelgron: Tale of the Sinner
data.detailed_description:
Between Heaven and Hell

Welcome to Evelgron - a world where the ancient balance between Heaven, Hell, and the realm of mortals has been shattered. As the boundaries between worlds begin to collapse, chaos spreads across creation, and powerful forces fight to shape its future.

You are not a chosen hero.

You are a soul that deserves to be in Hell.

Yet fate has granted you a second chance.

After escaping Hell with a powerful artifact stolen from an Archdemon, you find yourself caught in a struggle far greater than your own. Demons seek power, angels pursue their own vision of order, and lost souls fight for survival in a world on the brink of collapse.

Will you continue down the path that condemned you in life, using others for your own gain? Or will you seek redemption and become something greater than the person you once were?

Explore handcrafted semi-open regions, complete quests in different ways, uncover ancient secrets, discover powerful artifacts, and shape the story through meaningful choices and their consequences.

Dynamic Combat System

Switch between combat stances, combine melee attacks with powerful magic, and create your own fighting style. Face massive enemy hordes, dodge deadly attacks, survive intense bullet-hell encounters, and defeat powerful bosses in skill-based battles.

Platforming & Exploration

Test your skill with challenging platforming sections woven throughout the world. Leap across chasms, navigate dangerous obstacles, and uncover hidden routes leading to secret areas, powerful rewards, and places most players will never discover.

Epic Boss Battles

Face powerful bosses with unique mechanics, multiple combat phases, and deadly bullet-hell attacks. Learn their patterns, adapt your strategy, and survive increasingly challenging encounters that will test both your reflexes and mastery of combat.

A World Rich in Lore

Dive into a world filled with ancient mysteries, forgotten histories, and hidden truths waiting to be uncovered. Discover the stories of fallen heroes, lost souls, powerful demons, and celestial beings as you explore the world and piece together its dark past.

Choose Your Fate

• Story-driven dark fantasy Action RPG with meaningful choices and multiple endings

• Play as a predefined protagonist whose fate is shaped by your decisions

• Journey through dangerous lands inhabited by demons, lost souls, and other supernatural beings

• Multiple ways to approach quests and mission objectives

• Encounter angels, demons, and other factions with their own goals and motivations

• Define your path between redemption and damnation

data.short_description: You are not a hero. You are a sinner who belongs in Hell. A dark fantasy ARPG where your choices shape the story, quests can be completed in different ways, and exploration rewards the curious.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Ukrainian*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10500 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 Super / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT
  • Storage: 9 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains combat with depictions of blood, disturbing creatures, and dark themes including death, loss, and psychological horror elements. No explicit sexual content is present.
